jobs.description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. 
And we need people like you to make it happen.
We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.
Job Summary
At Tetra Pak we have built our brand on a commitment to innovation, customer focus, respect for the environment and social responsibility. We believe in an inclusive workplace supported by a strong vision, “We commit to making food safe and available, everywhere”. 
 
In the organisation HR Country Services, we are now looking for a new experienced and hands-on OHS Officer to continue to drive our Occupational Health and Safety program for the Nordic market. Your task will be to ensure delivery of the Corporate OHS strategy at different sites. The team is also responsible for establishing and maintaining the local OHS policies, guidelines, and procedures.
 
As our new colleague, you will work together with an experienced and committed team of OHS officers. You will have a broad network internally as well as externally including coordinating external consultants. In addition, you will also act as champion for a positive occupational health and safety culture across the entire site.
 
The position is permanent and based in Lund, Sweden. You will be required to travel around 25% of your time, mainly to customer sites in the Nordic and Baltic countries. You will report to HR Country Services Leader Nordics. Tetra Pak is not sponsoring work visas or relocation for this position.
What you will do
As OHS Officer you will:
Provide OHS advice and guidance to ensure compliance with Group OHS policy.
Establish, maintain, and monitor systems to support compliance with the Group OHS procedures and local legislation.
As required establish and monitor an OHS inspection program of customer sites.
Audit OHS on the site, register needs, and take necessary actions.
Improve safety awareness of employees and subcontractors.
You will monitor the Nordic legal framework, propose changes, and take corrective actions.
Advice and liaise with relevant stakeholders about legal risks, issues, and improvements

We believe you have
At least 7-10 years’ experience in OHS in an international environment, specifically including installation, commissioning and service environment.
Technical degree/diploma or University degree, preferably within Occupational, Health and Safety.
Excellent skills in Swedish and English, written as well as spoken.
Good knowledge within the legal framework of the Nordics countries.

To be successful in this role, you have proven change management skills and like to make a difference with the employees’ interest in mind. You are an effective relationship-builder who possess excellent communications skills and can build relations in a co-operative, diplomatic and successful manner. You have strong leadership abilities with experience of working proactively with OHS. We also believe you have experience to drive and implement changes in processes, behaviour and implementation of new systems and structures.
We Offer You
A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

 
Apply Now
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. 
This job posting expires on 2026-12-09.
If you have any questions about your application, please contact Emma Berndtsson at +46 733-364582. 
If you have questions about the position contact hiring manager, Peter Sacher at +46 733-364880. 
For trade union information: Akademikerklubben Lars Haraldsson at +46 46 36 2533, Unionen Lisbeth Larsson at +46 46 36 2320.

jobs.occupation: Norwegian-Speaking Customer Support Advisor  Gaming Industry | Cyprus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about gaming, technology, and providing excellent customer service? Have you ever dreamed of living abroad, enjoying sunny weather, and having the Mediterranean Sea just around the corner? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!
Jobs By Nordics is looking for a Norwegian-speaking Customer Support Advisor to join our international partner in Larnaca, Cyprus.
You'll become part of a team providing customer service and technical support for one of the world's most recognized brands in gaming and entertainment.
This is your opportunity to combine your interest in gaming with an international career while experiencing life on one of the Mediterranean's sunniest islands!
🎮 Your Responsibilities
As a Customer Support Advisor, you'll assist Norwegian-speaking customers with questions and technical issues related to gaming, consoles, and online services.
Your daily responsibilities will include:
Responding to customer inquiries via phone, email, and live chat.

Assisting customers with account access, password resets, and login issues.

Helping with payment processing and billing inquiries.

Troubleshooting technical issues involving gaming consoles and network services.

Delivering professional and friendly customer support.

Escalating more complex cases to the appropriate teams when necessary.

You'll receive comprehensive training to ensure you're fully prepared to support customers confidently.
💰 Salary & Benefits
Base salary: €1,350 gross per month.

Salary increase: €1,400 gross per month after 6 months.

Performance bonus: Average of €250–300 per month, depending on performance. The bonus is not guaranteed and has no fixed upper limit.

Income tax: 0% income tax in Cyprus at these salary levels, assuming no other taxable income affects your tax position. Mandatory social insurance and healthcare contributions still apply.

💼 Working Hours & Employment Conditions
Full-time position: 40 hours per week.

Monday to Friday, with rotating shifts between 09:00 and 19:30.

5 weeks of comprehensive training, Monday to Friday, 10:00–18:45.

2-year employment contract with the possibility of an indefinite contract afterward.

6-month probation period.

Office-based position in Larnaca, Cyprus.

✈️ Relocation Support – Your New Life in Cyprus!
If you're relocating to Cyprus from another EU country, the employer offers two relocation options.
Option 1 – €1,500 Relocation Allowance
Receive a €1,500 relocation allowance approximately 2–3 weeks after your employment begins.
You'll arrange and pay for your own flight and accommodation, giving you flexibility to choose where and how you want to live.
Option 2 – Flight Reimbursement & Temporary Accommodation
Potential reimbursement of flight costs up to €300.

Access to employer-provided accommodation for up to 2 months.

The first month of accommodation is free.

A second month may be available for an additional cost, subject to specific conditions.

Please note that staying for a second month affects eligibility for flight reimbursement, and additional accommodation fees may apply. Full relocation terms will be explained during the recruitment process.
🙋 Who Are We Looking For?
We're looking for someone who:
Speaks and writes Norwegian at a native or near-native level (C2).

Has good English communication skills (minimum B2).

Holds EU citizenship, as required by the employer.

Has completed secondary education or equivalent.

Is interested in gaming, technology, and problem-solving.

Is friendly, patient, and enjoys helping others.

Is willing to relocate to Larnaca or already lives in Cyprus.

Previous experience in customer service or technical support is an advantage, but not required.
☀️ Why Cyprus?
Imagine finishing your workday and heading straight to the beach, enjoying dinner by the sea, or exploring the island with your new international friends.
Larnaca offers a Mediterranean lifestyle with beautiful beaches, sunny weather, welcoming cafés, restaurants, and an international community.
Living and working abroad is also a great way to develop professionally, improve your language skills, and gain valuable international experience.
Whether you're looking to kick-start your international career or simply want a change of scenery, Cyprus could be the perfect next step!
📩 Ready for Your Next Adventure?
Expected start date: January 11, 2027
Application deadline: January 4, 2027
Apply today by submitting your application and CV through Jobs By Nordics.
If your profile matches the position, we'll contact you for an initial screening interview, where you'll learn more about the employer, the position, and the next steps.
The recruitment process includes an online language assessment followed by an interview with the employer.
Take the next step in your international career – we look forward to hearing from you!

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. 
 You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
 The Infrastructure Operations organization is seeking an exceptional leader to serve as a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Cluster Manager in Sweden. You will lead a large organization managing multiple data centers in the cluster, overseeing managers responsible for critical facility infrastructure. 
 The pace, scale, and growth of Amazon's data center platform will challenge you. We seek experienced senior leaders who are highly strategic in managing their business unit, yet lead by example and roll up their sleeves when required. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of data center and mission-critical MEP infrastructure. You will be responsible for maintaining 100% service uptime in our cluster, maintaining a high-level view while diving deep into details as needed. You will interact daily with global teams, representing Sweden Data Center Engineering Operations. 
 If you are passionate about customer experience, think and act globally, and want to contribute to the operational excellence of AWS data centers, this is the challenge you've been looking for. 
Key job responsibilities 
 Team Leadership & Development: Hire, manage, and develop the operations management team including Facility Managers, Chief Engineers, and Facility Technicians. Mentor and develop employees at all levels, including managers. 
 Operational Excellence: Ensure operation and maintenance of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for AWS data centers, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management. Maintain 100% service uptime across your cluster. 
 Performance Management: Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of critical facility operations and maintenance. Manage all facility-related repairs in a timely manner. 
 Organizational Structure: Build and maintain a sustainable organizational structure. Develop hiring strategy and participate in recruiting events. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business development, engineering, and construction teams to forecast staffing needs and maintain appropriate resource levels. 
 Vendor Management: Manage colocation data center service providers to meet or exceed contracted performance SLAs. Oversee on-site management of shift technicians, senior shift technicians, sub-contractors, and vendors, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with established practices and procedures. 
 Incident Management: Lead safety, security, and availability incident response, incident management, incident resolution, and root cause analysis. 
 Financial Management: Manage cost including OPEX and CAPEX associated with all data centers under your responsibility. 
 Reporting & Communication: Conduct daily/weekly/monthly Data Center Engineering Operations meetings and reporting. Run weekly availability meetings and report outcomes. 
 Global Integration: Liaise with global teams on initiatives, processes, and procedures; implement those initiatives locally in Sweden. 
 Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement of operational processes, procedures, methods, and tools. Lead and manage energy efficiency initiatives in your cluster. 
 Capacity Planning: Support capacity planning and management activities. 
About the team 
 You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Basic qualifications
Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams.
4+ years of experience operating as a manager of managers AND/OR 7+ years of relevant experience managing mission-critical facilities.
In-depth knowledge of data center facilities such as generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, UPS, electrical sub-distribution systems, fire detection and suppression systems, and cable reticulation systems.
Fluency in English to communicate effectively with global teams.
Driving license valid in EU.

Preferred qualifications
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or related fields.
Experience managing or implementing system health, performance monitoring, capacity planning, or process improvement and automation.
Experience supporting procedures for production or mission-critical environments including ticketing, monitoring/metrics, and troubleshooting technical issues.
Fluency in Swedish.

Company description:
"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."
Job description: 
 About the role:  
Are you an experienced credit professional with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to independently assess complex credit risks? Do you enjoy combining financial analysis and risk management with digital development and continuous improvement? Are you motivated by taking ownership, influencing decisions, and contributing to a strong credit culture? Then this could be the opportunity for you!At Volvo Financial Services, we are looking for a Senior Credit & Risk Analyst to strengthen our team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will play a key part in assessing and managing credit risk, supporting sound business decisions, and continuously improving the way we work. You will combine hands-on credit analysis with portfolio controlling, reporting, and the development of smarter, more scalable solutions.
 What you will do 
As Senior Credit & Risk Analyst, you will take an independent role in assessing complex credit cases and providing well-founded recommendations to support business decisions. You will prepare credit applications for larger transactions presented to relevant Credit Committees, ensuring high-quality financial analysis and clear recommendation rationale.You will also underwrite new business within your individual credit delegation and act as a voting member of various Credit Committees. Through your expertise and judgement, you will contribute to maintaining a sound risk balance while supporting the business and its customers.
 Beyond your core credit responsibilities, you will play an important role in developing and improving our credit and risk processes. You will drive the development and implementation of automated and scalable credit analysis and reporting solutions, leveraging AI, Power BI, and other data and analytics tools.
 You will also contribute to the design and maintenance of Swedish underwriting directives and procedures, ensuring alignment with relevant internal and external frameworks. In addition, you will support monthly and quarterly Credit & Risk reporting and contribute to the continuous quality assurance of our processes.
 We are a small team where collaboration, flexibility, and a willingness to support one another are essential. This means being comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities while also contributing to other activities and tasks across the team when needed.
 Who are you? 
You are a proactive and structured professional who enjoys taking ownership and driving things forward independently. You have a strong analytical mindset and the confidence to make sound credit assessments, even in complex situations. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying potential risks, and translating financial data into clear and well-founded recommendations.You combine strong financial and analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in digitalization and innovation. You are curious about how new technologies, particularly AI, can improve the way we work, and you enjoy identifying opportunities to make processes more efficient, automated, and scalable.
 As a person, you are collaborative and business-oriented. You understand the importance of balancing risk management with commercial priorities and maintaining a strong focus on customers. You communicate clearly, involve relevant stakeholders, and enjoy working together to achieve shared results.
 You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where being flexible, solution-oriented, and willing to learn is just as important as your technical expertise.
 To join us, we see that you have:• A university degree or MBA in Finance, Controlling, or a related field, or equivalent experience.• Solid experience in hands-on credit risk assessment and management within the financial services industry.• The ability to independently conduct complex credit analyses and provide well-founded credit recommendations.• Strong financial analysis and quantitative skills, with the ability to assess financial statements and evaluate credit risk.• Strong digital capabilities and experience using data and analytics tools, with an interest in incorporating AI into credit analysis and everyday workflows.• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Swedish.• Strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage your own responsibilities independently.• A collaborative mindset, with the ability to coordinate, involve, and work effectively with different stakeholders.
 Ready for the next move? 
Last Application Date: December 8th 2026
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.occupation: Regualtory Affairs Specialist Getinge Incfection control
jobs.description:
Company description:
Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.
Job description:About this opportunity  
  
 As Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge Disinfection, you provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes. You also perform and support product registrations and improve the process.
 You report to the Regulatory Affairs Manager and work closely with R&D, Technical Support, Production, Sourcing and management, as well as with the Regulatory and Product Compliance organization and authorities in different countries.
  
 In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide regulatory compliance and ensure successful product compliance for R&D and sustaining projects and changes.
  
  
 What you will do
  
  As a Regulatory Affairs Specialist at Getinge, you will play an important role in ensuring that our medical devices meet regulatory requirements throughout their lifecycle, from product development to market registration and post-market changes.
  
 Your main tasks will include:
  Prepare, compile, review, and support regulatory submissions for new product registrations, renewals, and amendments across international markets.
 Maintain existing regulatory approvals, licenses, and registrations and ensure renewals and regulatory updates are completed on time.
 Develop and support regulatory strategies for new product development projects, working closely with R&D, Quality, and other cross-functional teams.
 Assess the regulatory impact of product and design changes, including engineering change requests and change control activities
 Review and maintain regulatory technical documentation, including technical files, Design History Files (DHF), risk management documentation, and verification and validation records
 Monitor changes in international medical-device regulations, standards, and guidance and assess potential impact to existing and future products.
 Support regulatory information management systems and maintain accurate product registration data
 Review and approve product labeling, Instructions for Use (IFUs), and marketing materials to ensure regulatory compliance.
  
 
 This position is located in Växjö with the possibility to work 1-2 days from home. The role may require domestic and international travel.
  
  
 You will bring
  
 To be successful in this position, we believe that you have the following qualifications.
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Management or a related discipline.
 Experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, product development, or a related function within the medical device industry or another regulated environment.
 Experience with regulatory submissions, technical documentation, product registrations, or change control activities.
 Strong knowledge of applicable regulations and standards, e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDR
 Good Swedish and English skills, orally and written
 Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
 Good communication skills and the ability to work well in cross-functional teams
  
 
 In addition to your technical skills, we highly value your personality. You think strategically but pragmatically and are able to make decisions. You work independently and can take quick decisions within your area of responsibility.
  
 We think you have an ambition for growth and an eagerness for keeping up to date with the latest in medical device regulations and standards.
  
 At Getinge we see ourselves as proactive and self-driven in learning and contributing to the continued development of our products and our organization's capabilities.  We are Team Players, Forward Thinkers and Game Changers.
   
 We think you will thrive in a high-expectation environment and have an interest in our products.
  
 Application  
  
 Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-12-30
 We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.
  
 If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Hiring Manager Mohammad Fazel at email: mohammad.fazel@getinge.com  or Talent Partner Emma Paulsson at emma.paulsson@getinge.com.
  
 We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

jobs.occupation: R&D Engineer with Supply Chain Focus
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Are you an experienced design engineer looking for a new challenge beyond traditional R&D work?
In this role, you will be the technical link between R&D, our suppliers, and the supply chain organization. You will use your engineering background to support supplier qualifications, contribute to technical discussions on manufacturing solutions, and ensure that our design requirements are understood and fulfilled.
This is a new role with opportunities to influence and shape how we work. With suppliers located around the world, international travel will be a natural part of your work.
How You'll Make an Impact
Represent R&D in technical discussions and qualifications of new and existing suppliers.
Review and clarify technical requirements, drawings, and specifications together with suppliers and manufacturing teams.
Support technical evaluations and assessments of supplier capabilities.
Provide engineering support to Procurement, Supplier Quality, and internal manufacturing operations.
Contribute to improvements in component design, manufacturing processes, and supplier qualification methods.

What You Bring
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Experience in mechanical design and product development within R&D.
Experience working with 3D CAD, technical drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
Good understanding of manufacturing processes and technical requirements.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across different technical disciplines.
Good communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
Experience with manufacturing processes such as precision casting, machining, brazing, or coating is considered an advantage.

We Believe You Are
A curious and proactive engineer who enjoys working with people and exploring new technical challenges. You are comfortable taking responsibility, sharing your expertise, and building strong relationships with colleagues and suppliers. You enjoy combining engineering knowledge with a broader perspective on how components are manufactured and delivered.
About the Team
You will join our Turbine R&D team, responsible for the design and development of hot gas path components, including turbine blades and guide vanes, as well as turbine rotors for our SGT-600, SGT-700, SGT-750, and SGT-800 gas turbines.
Our team combines deep technical expertise with an open and supportive atmosphere where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are encouraged. Colleagues help each other and work together to solve technical challenges.
Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.
We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 298984 not later than 2026-12-14

Do you want to be a part building the next generation of platforms within fintech? Do you have solid experience in backend development and Java, and enjoy taking technical ownership? Are you excited by the opportunity to influence architecture, integrations and scalable solutions in a growing tech company? Then the role as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie could be the right opportunity for you!
About Yabie
Yabie is a Swedish fintech company that has been developing cloud-based POS systems and payment solutions since 2017. By combining payments, point-of-sale systems, sales and other features into a single platform, Yabie helps businesses simplify their daily operations and run their businesses more efficiently. Yabie continues to develop its technology and organisation to create even better and more scalable solutions.
About the role as Senior Software Engineer
As a Senior Software Engineer at Yabie, you will become an important part of the backend team and take clear ownership of developing and maintaining the systems that power Yabie's platform. Part of the role also involves expanding Yabie's API capabilities, including APIs and MCP setup, so that more partners can integrate with their solution. You will work hands-on with Java and Spring Boot, building backend services, APIs and integrations that connect Yabie's platform with partners and external systems. Your work will involve everything from designing new solutions to improving existing integrations, with a strong focus on quality, scalability and maintainability.
The tech team consists of approximately 20 people with expertise in backend development, mobile development, QA and DevOps. You will join the backend team alongside nine other backend developers. You will work closely with both the product teams and other developers, with great opportunities to influence technical solutions and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities:
Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
Design and develop integrations between Yabie, partners and external systems.
Contribute to architecture and scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot, optimise and improve existing services.

About you
We are looking for someone with a post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development or a similar field, alternatively equivalent professional experience. You have approximately five or more years of experience in backend development and have worked with Java and Spring Boot in a production environment. You have solid experience in API development, REST, integrations and databases, as well as an understanding of microservices and scalable systems. Experience with AWS is an advantage, as is working with API Gateways such as Kong.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and enjoy taking ownership of the bigger picture. You like understanding how different systems connect and feel comfortable developing technical solutions independently rather than simply implementing predefined specifications. You enjoy collaborating with others and are happy to share your technical knowledge with the team.
Important for the position:
Approximately 5+ years of experience in backend development, including Java, Spring Boot, REST, integrations and API development.
Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB, as well as AWS.
Understanding of microservices and software architecture.
Extensive experience with AI-assisted development and modern AI tools.
Fluent in English and preferably also Swedish, both spoken and written.

Additional qualifications that are considered a plus:
Experience with Kong.
A background in fintech or payment solutions.
Experience in data engineering or data modelling, and/or experience with Okta or a similar identity platform.

What Yabie offers
At Yabie, you will become part of a tech company where technology has a direct impact on customers' everyday operations. You will work with a platform used by approximately 10,000 businesses and have the opportunity to influence how the platform and its integrations evolve. Yabie actively embraces AI-assisted development and offers you great opportunities to influence both the technology and your own role.
Additional information
Start: By agreement.
Employment: Full-time.
Location: Stockholm.
Salary: By agreement.
Does the position as Senior Software Engineer to Yabie sound interesting to you? Submit your application today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis! We at Needo look forward to hearing from you!

Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services.
More and more of our network runs on open-source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you.
About the job
As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed.
Your day-to-day work may include:

Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments

Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms

Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash

Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites

Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core

Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve

Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec

Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure

This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions.
Key skills and experience we’re looking for:

Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments

Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking

Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec)

Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash)

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana

Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure

Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries

Good to have:

Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software

Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms

Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem

Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.)

About the position
Your primary focus will be the care and surgical treatment of patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma.
The role includes both outpatient care and day surgery, and you will be involved in the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients.
The work is characterised by close multidisciplinary and multiprofessional collaboration, where surgeons work together with other specialists and healthcare professionals throughout the patient's treatment pathway.
Most of the work is carried out during daytime hours. Depending on your individual competence and previous experience, participation in general surgical on-call duties may also be included.
Breast and melanoma surgery
The position is particularly suited to a general surgeon who already has clinical experience within breast surgery, melanoma surgery or related oncological surgery and wishes to continue developing within this field.
You will work with patients with breast cancer and malignant melanoma in a specialised surgical environment that combines clinical care with continuous development.
The broader surgical organisation also includes areas such as upper gastrointestinal surgery, endocrine and sarcoma surgery, as well as acute and trauma surgery.
A university hospital environment
The hospital offers an environment where specialised healthcare, education, clinical development and research are closely connected.
The breast and melanoma surgery field is research-intensive, and teaching and continuous development are natural parts of the position.
For a surgeon who wants to combine clinical expertise with continued academic and professional development, this provides an opportunity to build a long-term career within a large Swedish university hospital.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a Specialist in General Surgery who has a particular interest and relevant experience in breast and melanoma surgery.
You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary setting and are comfortable taking responsibility while contributing to the continued development of the department.
You value close collaboration with colleagues from different professions and specialties and have a patient-centred approach to your work.
Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised specialist qualification in General Surgery
Has relevant clinical experience
Has experience and a strong professional interest in breast surgery, melanoma surgery and/or related oncological surgery
Is comfortable managing patients throughout different stages of the surgical care pathway
Enjoys working in multidisciplinary and multiprofessional teams
Has a strong sense of responsibility and an interest in clinical development
Has good communication and collaboration skills
Has good English language skills
Is strongly motivated to learn Swedish and establish a long-term career in Sweden

For candidates who do not yet speak Swedish, language training is provided as part of the recruitment process.
What the hospital offers
You will have the opportunity to:
Work within specialised breast and melanoma surgery
Develop your competence within surgical cancer care
Work with both outpatient consultations and surgical treatment
Become part of an established multidisciplinary cancer care environment
Participate in teaching and continuous clinical development
Work in a research-intensive university hospital environment
Collaborate with experienced specialists across different medical and surgical disciplines
Continue developing both clinically and academically

What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Interested?
We look forward to hearing from you!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)
jobs.description:
Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)
Reference number PAR 2026/894
The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
The Department of Health and Care Sciences conducts education and research focusing on healthcare, health and people's living conditions. We educate nurses, radiographers, specialist nurses and midwives, with the aim of meeting society's need for skilled and committed healthcare professionals.
Research at the Department covers a wide range of areas, with a shared foundation in person-centred and evidence-based care. We are nationally and internationally recognised as a leader in person-centred care, an approach that underpins our education, research and collaboration with healthcare providers.
The Department is part of Sahlgrenska Academy at the University of Gothenburg and is located at Campus Medicinareberget, close to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. This provides an environment characterised by interprofessional collaboration, strong links to clinical practice and high academic standards. The Department has approximately 1,200 students enrolled in first- and second-cycle programmes leading to professional qualifications in healthcare.
We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and with different experiences and perspectives. We value diversity and actively promote an inclusive and equal working environment where all employees have opportunities to thrive and develop. To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer flexible working arrangements.
The University of Gothenburg is a Swedish government agency, which means that employees benefit from favourable employment conditions, generous annual leave and an occupational pension scheme.
Read more about working at the University of Gothenburg on our website: Work at the University of Gothenburg
We are looking for a colleague with a strong interest in teaching and a commitment to course development and the advancement of teaching and learning. The successful applicant should be highly motivated to share knowledge with students and demonstrate a strong commitment to educational development.
The position will primarily be based in the Section for Diagnostics and Care in Acute and Critical Conditions / Reproductive and Perinatal Health. Teaching will mainly take place within the Midwifery Programme. Depending on operational needs, duties may also involve collaboration with other sections within the Department.
Subject area 
Reproductive and perinatal health
Subject area description 
Reproductive and perinatal health is grounded in a humanistic view of the person and generates knowledge about human reproduction and its processes. This encompasses sexuality, fertility, abortion, contraception, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, the neonatal period, parenthood and menopause.    
Duties 
Teaching will primarily focus on subject-specific areas related to the midwifery profession and its core competencies: person-centred care, safe care, health informatics, teamwork, evidence-based care, leadership, interprofessional learning and pedagogy.
The duties include teaching and assessment, course coordination, supervision of degree projects and supervision of students during clinical placements. 
The position primarily involves planning and teaching at second-cycle level, keeping up to date with developments in relevant subject areas, the professional role of the midwife, person-centred leadership and clinically integrated learning. The duties also include teaching and supervision at first-cycle level, as well as course coordination at both first- and second-cycle levels.
As course coordinator, responsibilities include developing and coordinating learning outcomes, learning activities, assessment methods and assessment criteria in relation to course content, objectives and current research in higher education pedagogy. Acting as a university liaison for students undertaking clinical placements is an important part of the position. The role also involves ensuring the quality of education through validated evaluation methods. Some teaching of clinical skills is also included.
Administrative duties related to educational activities constitute a significant part of the role. Other duties may also be assigned, and the responsibilities associated with the position may change over time.
The position also involves actively contributing to the achievement of the Department's objectives and operational plan. This includes supporting the development of the academic environment within the section's Complete Academic Environment (KAM). In addition, all staff members are expected to participate in scheduled departmental meetings and joint activities.
The successful candidate will teach in both Swedish and English.
See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.
Göteborgs universitet | Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer to a Fast-Growing Scandinavian Brand!
jobs.description:
If you're passionate about data, code, and AI, take pride in getting the numbers right, and want to build the data and AI platform behind a fast-growing beauty brand, we'd love to hear from you. Send us your application today!
About the role
Our client is a Stockholm-based global beauty brand. They develop premium, high-performing products at accessible price points, defined by quality and a Scandinavian aesthetic. Driven by an entrepreneurial and creative culture, they combine modern brand storytelling with operational excellence.
Every decision across their organisation, from which shades to restock to which campaigns to scale or markets to expand into, starts with data. Their modern data platform unifies e-commerce, advertising, and retail metrics, while custom AI assistants empower teams to interact with that data directly.
As a Data & AI Engineer, you will join their Tech team and report directly to the CTO. You will collaborate closely with marketing, finance, and operations to build and run the pipelines, services, and AI tooling powering company-wide analytics. From modelling sales data in Dataform to deploying an MCP server that lets AI assistants query BigQuery, you will ensure stakeholders have access to reliable, documented, and timely figures.
This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career or with a couple of years of experience who writes solid SQL, values clean and well-tested code, builds with AI daily, and wants ownership of production systems at a rapidly scaling brand.
Work tasks
You will build and maintain data pipelines, models, and AI-driven services to support business reporting, analytics, and data-informed decisions across the company:
Build and maintain data models in Dataform and BigQuery (incremental models, assertions, and cost-aware partitioning/clustering).  
Ingest data from source systems (e-commerce, advertising platforms, ERP, and retail partners) into BigQuery with scheduling, alerting, and backfills.  
Write and deploy Python or TypeScript services on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Scheduler) with proper IAM, secrets management, and logging.  
Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations to translate ambiguous business questions into precise data models and queries.  
Build, deploy, and maintain MCP servers on Cloud Run to connect AI assistants to internal data, applying least-privilege IAM and monitoring.  
Maintain the semantic layer for AI assistants (defining metrics once, writing metadata and catalog documentation, and solving data discrepancies at the source).  
Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as your default development workflow-writing clear task specs, critically reviewing outputs, and shipping tested code via CI/CD.  
Support internal teams in expanding their AI workflows and setting up custom assistants.

We are looking for
A university degree (BSc or MSc) in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, information systems, or an equivalent field. A focus on data science is a strong plus.
2–4 years of experience in big data and data modeling — internships, thesis work, and serious side projects count.
Solid SQL – joins, window functions, data grain and incremental models.
Hands-on coding in Python or TypeScript; you can write, test and debug a small service on your own.
Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally Google Cloud.
An AI-native way of working – you use coding agents daily and know when not to trust their output.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain what you built, and why, to non-technical colleagues.
Curiosity, a quick learning curve and comfort in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent Swedish and English.

It is meritorious if you have
Production experience with BigQuery, and with Dataform or dbt.
Experience with dimensional modelling and data quality testing.
An understanding of containers, service accounts, least-privilege access and basic networking.
Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer brands.
Experience building or integrating LLM-based tooling – MCP, function calling or agents. Side projects count.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Stress tolerant
Goal oriented
Orderly
Responsible
Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

The opportunity  
We are looking for a Line Planner for Control & Protection, Automation and Cybersecurity at HVDC to act as the center of expertise for planning and scheduling within the Line Planning organization. In this role, you will ensure that best execution practices are applied in tenders and projects and will actively contribute to planning, monitoring, and reporting within your group. You will also provide operational support to the project planners and project managers within HVDC Control & Protection, Automation, and Cybersecurity teams on an ad-hoc basis. This is a role with many interfaces and interesting work tasks within engineering and supply chain planning.
This role requires operating with strict deadlines while conducting scenario-based analysis as a core part of daily responsibilities.
This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 
How you’ll make an impact  
The Line Planner is responsible for overseeing availability of resources on a macro level to ensure timely delivery of C&P scope within projects. 
Support line and project managers in planning methodology and understanding delivery targets linked to their scope. 
The Line Planner develops specific expertise in planning and execution of the line organizations scope in EPC HVDC deliveries. 
Establish accurate scheduling methods, best execution practices, and ensure that this is reflected in type schedules applied in project and tenders. 
Compiles information, analyses and makes recommendations in formats that assist in effective management and decision making. 
Work with line managers to align material and space requirements and availability as per the scope of projects and tenders. 
Assist project managers in tenders and projects startup phase to ensure that best planning and execution practices are applied. 
Identify and mitigate bottlenecks and risks operational continuity from material and space aspect. 
Collaboration with various stakeholders involved in the process. 

Your background  
You have a degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field. 
Knowledge and 5+ years of experience from engineering/ resource planning, preferably with Energy sector. 
You are structured, flexible, and have some qualifications in project management. 
You have skills in planning and controlling a time schedule and have prior experience using Primavera P6 or MS Project. 
You have genuine technical interest and are always open to developing your skills within other fields. 
Knowledge of how to use Microsoft's Office suite of software, especially Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint. 
Fluent in written / spoken English, Swedish language skills would be an advantage. 
You are a dynamic and social person who enjoys working with people from various business areas and parts of the world. 

More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​ 
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​
